summary: VERIFY-phase independent validation of SD-LEO-INFRA-DURABLE-HOURLY-HEARTBEAT-001 (PR #7031, commit 7eb83365dcf). The mechanism is genuinely delivered, empirically well-calibrated against live production data, and minimally invasive. All three prior merge-blockers (F1 calendar-bucket, SEC-H1 uncredentialed inline dispatch, F6 self-re-enqueue) are fixed AND each is pinned by a test that would fail if reverted. No NEW merge-blocker found. Residual items are documentation drift in the SD/PRD text (4 findings), one half-delivered MEDIUM FR (FR-4), and one honestly-documented residual design gap (machine-off dispatch). Recommend shipping with 3 pre-approval doc corrections and 1 follow-up SD.
warnings: G-A [MEDIUM, doc] All 4 strategic_directives_v2.success_criteria are STALE - they still describe the pre-revision design. Every one of the 4 'measure' fields names sendChairmanSMS (which the shipped code deliberately never calls); (a) and (b) name the 'current chairman-zone hour' calendar bucket (replaced by the trailing window per F1); (c) names '06:00-22:00' (the shipped coarse filter is 05:00-22:59 + an explicit quiet-hours gate). The INTENT of all four is met and genuinely tested, but a LEAD reader comparing measure-text to code would wrongly conclude (a) and (b) were not delivered. PRD metadata.post_merge_revisions correctly records the pivot; that record was never propagated to the SD row. Same class as 'a correction lands on one access path, the others keep serving stale'.

G-B [MEDIUM, doc] PRD FR-2 body text was never revised for F1 - it still reads 'created within the current chairman-zone hour' in both its description and its acceptance_criteria, i.e. it still documents the defective calendar-bucket design that F1 (merge-blocking) removed. FR-2c and FR-3 were revised; FR-2 was not.

G-C [LOW-MED, spec-vs-code] PRD FR-2b AC#2 ('the staleness/grace-floor threshold is a single named constant used for both the live-owed-stuck case AND the backstop-failed-retry case') is now literally false. The F6 fix made STALENESS_GRACE_MS apply ONLY to the live path: ownKind=true bypasses it entirely, and failed/undelivered ignore it for both kinds. The constant still influences backstop re-fill cadence indirectly via LOOKBACK_MS = SLA_WINDOW_MS + STALENESS_GRACE_MS. Correct design change, un-updated spec.

G-D [LOW, stale AC bullets] PRD FR-3's description was revised for SEC-H1 but two AC bullets were not. AC#1 'Sweep does not import or duplicate isSmsQuietHour/inQuietHours logic itself' contradicts both the code (line 67 imports isSmsQuietHour) and its own revised description ('isSmsQuietHour ... reused, not reimplemented'). AC#2 'A stubbed sendChairmanSMS quiet-hours-block response is correctly surfaced as no-send' references a call path that no longer exists.

G-E [MEDIUM, scope] PRD FR-4 is HALF delivered. FR-4 requires a builder that 'reads durable state relevant to the last hour for a backstop-tagged line, falling back to a minimal presence line if durable state is unreadable', with AC 'When durable state is readable, content includes a real status line tagged as a backstop fill'. buildBackstopBody (sweep line 200) reads NO durable state at all - it always emits the fallback presence line plus hourKey and the two coverage verdicts. The 'never fabricates an all-good' half IS delivered and tested (test line 332). The 'last-hour delta from durable state' half is not implemented and no test covers it. Also sits against the chairman's standing hourly-update content contract (last-hour numbers + natural language). Not merge-blocking (an honest degraded presence line beats nothing on a fallback path), but the PRD claims a capability the code does not have.

G-F [MEDIUM, residual design gap - name this to LEAD explicitly] In the machine-off scenario that is the SD's stated ROOT CAUSE, the backstop ENQUEUES cloud-side but there is NO unconditional cloud-side DISPATCHER. Independently verified: (1) ZERO GHA workflows run scripts/cron/sms-outbound-reconcile-sweep.mjs; (2) chairman-morning-brief-cron.yml and chairman-morning-review-cron.yml carry only TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_URL (no ACCOUNT_SID/AUTH_TOKEN) so they are genuinely enqueue-only, confirming the sweep header's precedent claim; (3) the ONLY GHA job with full Twilio credentials is fleet-down-alert-cron.yml (every 15 min, all day) and it dispatches only when verdict.alert is true (scripts/fleet-down-alert.mjs:235 'if (!verdict.alert) return;'). So during a total machine-off outage the backstop's owed rows are delivered only if/when fleet-down-alert independently trips (its inline reconcileOutboundSms claims any owed row, unscoped by kind), otherwise they wait for the machine to return. That is safety-by-coincidence, not by design. MITIGATING: this is honestly and accurately documented in the sweep header ('drained by whatever credentialed process next calls sendChairmanSMS for any reason ... the SAME dispatch dependency the already-shipped morning-brief/morning-review sweeps have, not a new one'), the enqueue-only pivot was security-mandated by SEC-H1, and the SD's literal criterion (a) - delivery when the Adam ScheduleWakeup lags - IS fully satisfied for the ScheduleWakeup-lag case (machine on => the local reconcile sweep drains within minutes). The residual gap is confined to the machine-off case, where 'durable' means 'durably recorded and eventually delivered', not 'delivered on the hour'.

G-G [INFO] Under a sustained outage, fills occur once per LOOKBACK_MS (~65 min) rather than once per 60 min, so a 10-hour outage records ~9 fills, not 10. Deliberate consequence of LOOKBACK_MS = SLA_WINDOW_MS + STALENESS_GRACE_MS; pinned by the F6 regression test's expected count of 2 over 105 minutes. Cosmetic.
G-H [INFO] 8 scratch .artifacts/heartbeat-*.mjs scripts (~530 LOC) are committed to the branch. Consistent with existing repo convention.
recommendations: SHOULD, before LEAD-FINAL-APPROVAL: update strategic_directives_v2.success_criteria to describe the SHIPPED design (enqueueChairmanSms not sendChairmanSMS; trailing lookback window not calendar hour; 05:00-22:59 coarse pre-filter + explicit isSmsQuietHour gate). Pure DB text edit, no code change. This matters because LEAD literally reads success_criteria to decide 'was this delivered' - as written they describe a design the code deliberately and correctly rejected.

SHOULD: update PRD FR-2 body/AC for the F1 trailing-window pivot, FR-2b AC#2 for the F6 ownKind carve-out, and FR-3 AC#1/AC#2 stale bullets - so a future reader who greps the FR text (not the metadata) does not resurrect the defective design.

SHOULD: either implement FR-4's durable-state read or explicitly de-scope FR-4 in the PRD to 'minimal presence line only' with a follow-up item, rather than leaving the PRD claiming an unimplemented capability.

RECOMMEND follow-up SD: close the machine-off dispatch gap with a cloud-side reconcile runner carrying real Twilio credentials AND - critically - a kind-scoped claim, since reconcileOutboundSms's unscoped status='owed' claim is the pre-existing defect that forced the SEC-H1 pivot in the first place. Fixing the claim scoping is the prerequisite, not the credentials.
